description: This file defines a class 'FieldInfos' which manages bookmark information during document rendering, including adding bookmarks and retrieving page numbers associated with bookmarks.

classes.name: FieldInfos
classes.description: A class that maintains and manages bookmark info for rendering documents, allowing adding and retrieving page numbers for bookmarks.

methods.name: AddBookmark
methods.description: Adds a bookmark with its associated page number if the current physical page number is valid.

methods.name: GetShownPageNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the display page number for a given bookmark.

methods.name: GetPhysicalPageNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the physical page number for a given bookmark.
